PURPOSE: Define a deterministic, snapshot-bound source universe for canonical finding manifests so active authority-bound findings cannot be omitted merely because their definition is outside NEXY-BUILD-CONTROL/FINDINGS/**.
AUTHORITY_CLAUSES: [062] CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 must be derived from a complete canonical finding manifest.
[063] Only exact terminal non-blocking states defined by authority may be treated as non-blocking.

SNAPSHOT_BINDING.RULE: Every generated universe manifest MUST be derived entirely from one pinned control commit/tree. Mixing rows from different control commits is invalid.

PRIMARY_SOURCE.ENUMERATION: Recursively enumerate every tracked regular file under ROOT at the pinned control tree.
PRIMARY_SOURCE.ACCOUNTING: Every enumerated file MUST receive exactly one SOURCE_CLASSIFICATION row; no silent filename or extension omission is allowed.
PRIMARY_SOURCE.JSON_DEFINITION_RULE: A JSON file is a FINDING_DEFINITION only when the parsed top-level object contains non-empty string FINDING_ID.
PRIMARY_SOURCE.MARKDOWN_DEFINITION_RULE: A Markdown file is a FINDING_DEFINITION only when its leading metadata header before the first blank line contains exactly one non-empty FINDING_ID: <id> field.
PRIMARY_SOURCE.PARSE_ERROR_RULE: Any file intended or detected as a finding definition whose identifier cannot be parsed deterministically is PARSE_ERROR and blocks completeness.

AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_SOURCES.ACTIVE_BOOTSTRAP_FENCE: The active BOOTSTRAP_FENCE_STATE when Mission Fence does not yet exist.
AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_SOURCES.ACTIVE_GLOBAL_TRANSITION: Any active immutable global-transition intent/state that canonically binds finding identifiers.
REFERENCE_FIELDS: schema-defined finding-id fields in active global-transition authority records

EXTERNAL_FINDING_LOCATORS.REQUIRED_WHEN: An authority-referenced FINDING_ID is not defined by PRIMARY_SOURCE.
EXTERNAL_FINDING_LOCATORS.RESOLUTION_RULE: At the pinned control snapshot, DEFINITION_PATH MUST exist and its parsed definition identifier MUST equal FINDING_ID exactly. A locator is not authority to change severity or status.
EXTERNAL_FINDING_LOCATORS.STALE_LOCATOR_RULE: Observed blob/tree evidence may aid audit, but generation MUST resolve the locator against the pinned control snapshot rather than trusting an older blob SHA.

NORMALIZED_FINDING_ROW.RAW_FIELD_RULE: SEVERITY_RAW and STATUS_RAW preserve source spelling/value exactly; this universe layer performs no semantic control-vs-product classification and no resolved-like status normalization.

IDENTITY_AND_DUPLICATES.SAME_PATH_MULTI_SOURCE: If one definition path is reached through primary enumeration and an authority reference, emit one normalized finding row and union its authority-reference paths.
IDENTITY_AND_DUPLICATES.DISTINCT_PATH_DUPLICATE_ID: If the same FINDING_ID resolves to more than one distinct definition path, completeness FAILS with DUPLICATE_FINDING_ID_CONFLICT. Do not pick one silently.

ORDERING.SOURCE_FILE_ROWS: UTF-8 byte ordering by canonical repository path.
ORDERING.NORMALIZED_FINDING_ROWS: UTF-8 byte ordering by FINDING_ID, then DEFINITION_PATH.
ORDERING.AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_PATHS: UTF-8 byte ordering with exact duplicates removed.

COMPLETENESS_PASS_REQUIRES: all files under PRIMARY_SOURCE.ROOT at the pinned snapshot are source-accounted
every authority-referenced FINDING_ID resolves to exactly one finding definition
every external resolution is backed by an exact locator path valid at the pinned snapshot
manifest rows are normalized and sorted exactly by this contract
manifest records the exact pinned control commit/tree identities used for enumeration
FORBIDDEN: treating NEXY-BUILD-CONTROL/FINDINGS/** alone as proof of universe completeness when active authority references an external finding
dropping an authority-bound finding because its file is outside the primary root
classifying control-vs-product relevance in this universe layer
changing finding status or severity while normalizing
prefix-normalizing RESOLVED_* or another status into a terminal state
computing CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH from a universe that has not passed all completeness conditions

OUTPUT_SEPARATION.CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH: computed only after universe completeness and projection validity are independently established
